title: Magento 2 reindex pinned MySQL to 100%: a stale flat row
lede: A Magento 2 catalog reindex pinned MySQL at 100% CPU at 07:14 on a Tuesday. The culprit was 47 orphan rows in catalog_product_flat_1. Here is the trace.
hero_alt: Overhead shot of bone linen desk with Magento 2 reindex run-sheet, ER blueprint, index cards, fountain pen, red wax seal.
